name: link
description: The companion core's side on a server: pairing a Windows PC's local core under its desktop app device and verifying its signed calls.

tips.text: Run `vyre link` on your Mac to see whether it is paired with the box and can reach it now.
Run `vyre link pair <address>` on your Mac, then type the code it shows into the card on Now.
Approve a Mac's pairing from your phone or another device with your passkey; a box terminal can't approve it.
Run `vyre link` on the box to list the paired Macs and any Mac waiting to be approved.
Run `vyre link unpair` on the Mac to forget the box, or `vyre link unpair <id>` on the box to drop a Mac.
Run `vyre link signin` so this Mac's CLI and Capsule can answer and approve on the box for 30 days.
Continue a thread marked alex-mac on that Mac; the box's Deck shows it read-only and keeps no copy.
